cases.explain: «последние слова» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:

cases.sentence: Тогда те трое воинов пробились через филистимский лагерь, зачерпнули воды из колодца у ___ и принесли Давиду.
cases.explain: «вифлеемских ворот» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Ванея, сын Иодая, был ___ из Кавцеила, совершившим великие подвиги.
cases.explain: «доблестным воином» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.
